_keys_note: Discrete(85) full command set; we expose movement + eat. Compass 0-7 (0=N,1=E,2=S,3=W,4=NE,5=SE,6=SW,7=NW); 29=EAT. Arrows map to the cardinals, y/u/b/n to the diagonals, E to eat. Y (act 7) sends keystroke 'y'='yes' and N (act 5) sends 'n'='no' at a [ynq] prompt. turn_based:true is required -- noop is action 0 (=move N). Keep the instructions' Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.
_curriculum_note: Blocking: the block is this task played until completed (mode 'episode', n_episodes 1, advancing_outcomes ['won']); a death or the env's own step limit restarts the same level, and max_duration 300 s is the cap. ESC is the experimenter's way out.

instructions.title: MiniHack: Eat
text: You're hungry. Walk onto the food, then eat it in
two steps:  press  E  to eat, then  Y  to confirm.
ARROWS       move  N / S / W / E
Y / U        move diagonally  NW / NE     (Y = 'yes')
B / N        move diagonally  SW / SE     (N = 'no')
E  then  Y   eat the food you're standing on
